summary: frontend-orb preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's npm preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs") downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun at install time and immediately uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated blob using the obfuscator.io shape (hex identifiers, a shuffled ~1000-entry numeric/string constant array, a rotation function that pushes/shifts the array). The package is advertised as a CircleCI orb and ships YAML configuration under src/; a CircleCI orb has no legitimate need for a preinstall hook, a second language runtime, or a 700KB obfuscated JavaScript payload. The loader path (preinstall → fetch alternate runtime → execute obfuscated sibling) fires automatically on every npm install and is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to evade Node-based scanners by running the payload under Bun instead of Node.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
